facts.fact: The Ministry of Health of Cabo Verde says the Global Fund-financed DHIS2 implementation bought 62 computers, handed to the national health directorate on 12 December 2023 for health delegations and health centres.

The Ministry of Health of Cabo Verde says the CCSSIDA handed 62 Global Fund-financed computers to the national health directorate on 12 December 2023 to reinforce the DHIS2 health information system for the country's health delegations and health centres.
